# [Brand Name]

> One-paragraph description of what the company does, who it serves, and where it operates. Keep it factual: an AI assistant will often quote this sentence verbatim. Include the country/market and the core offering.

Key facts an assistant should know:

- Founded: [YYYY] in [City, Country]
- Category: [e.g. GEO / AI visibility auditing]
- Languages served: [e.g. Hungarian, English]
- Contact: [email] / [phone]

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://example.com/docs/getting-started): How to set up the product in under 10 minutes.
- [API reference](https://example.com/docs/api): Endpoints, auth, rate limits.
- [FAQ](https://example.com/faq): Answers to the questions prospects ask most.

## Product

- [Pricing](https://example.com/pricing): Tiers, what is included in each, currency.
- [Changelog](https://example.com/changelog): Dated list of releases.

## Company

- [About](https://example.com/about): Team, mission, registered entity.
- [Contact](https://example.com/contact): How to reach a human.

## Optional

- [Blog archive](https://example.com/blog): Long-form articles; skip if you only need the essentials.
- [Press kit](https://example.com/press): Logos, boilerplate, media contacts.
